body:
Part 1 of #1206 — the allocation-site half (N5 follow-up to #645 / #662). The read-site half (B1–B5 in #1206) needs a write-site design and stays open there, so this PR deliberately does not close the issue.

## Problem

SPEC-LANGUAGE N5/N3: a zero map is the empty map and its first write allocates. #662 lowered that at *declaration* sites (`var`, struct literals, `new(T)`) and recorded arrays and `make([]bag, n)` elements as not covered. Every program below passed `hyb check`, built, and panicked `assignment to entry in nil map`:

```hy
gs := make([]graph, 2);        gs[0].nodes[1] = 10
ms := make([]map[string]int, 2); ms[0]["a"] = 1
bs := make([]bag, 0, 4); bs = bs[:1]; bs[0].counts["k"] = 1
var arr [2]graph;              arr[0].nodes[1] = 10
lit := [2]bag{};               lit[1].counts["k"] = 1
```

## Fix (hy-emit only; no checker change)

`make` and `[N]T` are declaration sites in disguise — the element type is known structurally, so the existing `zeroinit.rs` table applies:

| Hybrid | emitted Go |
|---|---|
| `make([]bag, n)` / `make([]bag, n, c)` / `make(bags, n)` (alias) | `hy_n5_make(func() bag { return bag{counts: map[string]int{}} }, n[, c])` |
| `var a [2]bag`, `[2]bag{}`, `var s shelf` (array field), `make([][2]bag, n)` | `func() (hyArr [2]bag) { for i := range hyArr { hyArr[i] = bag{…} }; return hyArr }()` |
| `[3]bag{bag{label: "x"}}` (partial literal, literal N) | trailing elements padded with the N5 init |
| `make([]int, n)`, `make([]plain, n)`, `make(chan bag, 1)`, `var e [2]int`, `[2]int{}` | **unchanged** (Go's zero value already is Hybrid's) |

`hy_n5_make` is a 10-line generic prelude helper, emitted only when used (same gate as `hy_pop`). It allocates every slot up to the capacity and returns `s[:n]`, so a reslice within the capacity meets N5 values too. Go's `make` accepts any integer size type; non-literal sizes are wrapped in `int(...)` for the helper.

Why an IIFE for arrays: it is one expression for any `N` (literal or const identifier), so the same init serves `var`, literals, struct fields and nested element types; no literal expansion, no statement-level special case.

Not covered, deliberately (no allocation site — a READ produces the zero value): a missing map element (`mm[k][k2] = v`, `b, ok := m[k]`) and a closed-channel receive. Those need a write-site design (proposed in the issue) and are called out in `zeroinit.rs`'s header instead of being silently left.

## Tests

- **Corpus** (accept side): `tests/checker-corpus/n5-zero-map-allocation-sites.hy` — make / make-with-cap + reslice / make of maps / array var, literal, const-length, partial literal / make inside a struct literal reaching a callee; single-line `EXPECTED-OUTPUT: 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 x 7 3`, registered in VERDICTS.md and the corpus README. Census bumped on all 7 surfaces (127 programs: ACCEPT 39 · ACCEPT-MANAGED 2 · REJECT 86); `python3 tools/check_corpus_census.py` agrees.
- **hy-emit** `tests/n5_zero_map_lowering.rs`: `n5_make_slice_allocates_every_element` (+ the unchanged-shape controls and the prelude signature), `n5_make_prelude_is_emitted_only_when_used`, `n5_arrays_allocate_every_element` (var / literal / const length / partial / struct field / unchanged `[2]int`).
- **hyb** `tests/spec_n5_zero_maps.rs`: `n5_allocation_sites_corpus_program_output` builds and runs the fixture byte-exact.
- Local (go1.26.9 / rust 1.99.0, darwin/arm64): `cargo test --workspace` green; `tools/corpus_harness.py` 127/127; `tools/differential_loop.py` accept side 41/41 incl. the new fixture, reject side 86/86; `tools/run_examples.sh` 10/10 byte-exact.
- Package mode: the prelude is injected by `emit_go_package` too — a `pub fn` doing `make([]bag, n)` built with `hyb build --package` and with `hyb generate` on a copy of `examples/gomod-integration` compiles and its tests pass; the committed `calc.hy.go` regenerates byte-identical.

## Note on third-party duplicate PR #1207 (`@Dimank92`)

- **Original Reporter & Commit Provenance:** I (`@planners1490`) reported #1206 at `18:20 UTC` with the full `hy_n5_make` / `TypeExpr::Array` design and `n5-zero-map-allocation-sites.hy` specification in the issue body (*"PR to follow, patch ready"*), and committed `429665c` at `18:22 UTC` — prior to `@Dimank92`'s fork (`18:52 UTC`) and PR #1207 (`19:27 UTC`).
- **Why this PR is gate-clean whereas #1207 fails CI:**
  1. **All 7 census surfaces updated (`tools/check_corpus_census.py` exits 0):** PR #1207 only updated 5 surfaces and missed `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `Makefile`, and `README.md` (leaving them at `126`), plus stripped the UTF-8 BOM and introduced CRLF in `tests/checker-corpus/VERDICTS.md`.
  2. **`--package` mode (`emit_go_package`):** This PR injects `N5_MAKE_PRELUDE` in both binary and `--package` emission paths; #1207 omits `emit_go_package`.
  3. **Non-literal integer length/capacity types:** Go's `make` accepts any integer type (`int32`, `uint`, etc.), whereas generic `hy_n5_make` takes `int`; this PR wraps non-literal lengths/capacities in `int(...)`.
